kitchen.summary: Your child is learning to describe and use functions — writing function notation, finding domain and range, reading key features of graphs, calculating average rates of change, and building linear models from real situations.
kitchen.q: If {{name}} is told h(t) gives a ball's height after t seconds, can they explain what h(2) = 15 means?
ev: Solves f(x) = 7 for a given function
Interprets h(2) = 15 in a context such as height after 2 seconds

step.desc: Explain covalent bonding as a shared pair of electrons between non-metal atoms, and draw dot-and-cross and displayed diagrams for simple molecules such as H₂, H₂O, CH₄ and CO₂

from.why: Sharing electrons to fill outer shells requires knowing shell arrangements
Recognising non-metals tells you when covalent bonding is expected
